cases.expected: Selected web/PWA/Play/iOS/sideload route matches actual distribution/storefront/program eligibility; unsupported payment CTAs are unavailable.
Server-approved product/plan/cycle/seat mapping rejects arbitrary product, unsupported quantity and wrong environment/app.
Native displayed localized product/offer price matches provider checkout; client amount/currency or finance FX cannot determine entitlement.
Price/configuration changes invalidate unsubmitted quotes while accepted invoice amounts and future effective terms remain preserved.
Null/unconfigured, zero/no-charge and Free plan paths remain distinct; no implied paid purchase or fake receipt.
Business purchase availability and complete pricing constraints are enforced directly, including stale/cached clients.
Own active workspace can submit valid server-priced Personal/Family requests; foreign/non-owner/anonymous/suspended direct calls fail.
Proof path/object/metadata and private access remain bound to actor/workspace/payment; invalid files and unauthorized signing are denied.
Business pending quote/payment and public-purchase submission retries preserve one invoice/request and accepted quote identity.
Approved/rejected review replay has no duplicate financial or entitlement effect; exact allowed staff roles and required MFA are enforced.
Business self-review restriction, suspension and invoice/workspace/owner binding hold through private and public review delegation.
Authorized manual/test grants retain bounded dates/reason/audit and create no fabricated provider purchase or payment receipt.
Genuine selected sandbox purchase is verified by the trusted backend/provider before a server entitlement is granted.
Forged client success, screenshot, JSON verified flag or unverified JWS/token creates no store entitlement.
Wrong package/bundle/product/environment, invalid signing chain/signature or untrusted provider response is rejected.
Purchase/transaction is bound to server-approved account/workspace intent; wrong account, email alias or attacker-selected workspace is denied.
Pending/failed/canceled purchase yields the correct non-grant state; repeated client callback cannot add extra time or capacity.
Renewal/linked-token/transaction chain retains one rightful owner; cross-account reuse and mistaken source transfer are rejected.
Google push receiver verifies configured JWT/claims and re-fetches authoritative purchase state before projecting entitlements.
Apple signed notification/transaction/renewal data is verified for selected environment and app; altered payload is rejected.
Any selected web-provider callback follows its own actual raw-body/signature/replay protocol; no generic trust-by-body.
Duplicate/reordered notifications and concurrent client/worker claims preserve one logical transition and do not extend time twice.
Provider timeout, acknowledgment ambiguity and partial database failure retain durable retry/reconciliation without false completion.
Transport message dedup and business purchase-chain state are separate; forged old events cannot roll back a newer accepted state.
Renewal updates the server-derived entitlement window once; server times and verified status override caller timestamps.
Cancellation preserves access through the legitimate paid term where applicable; expiry removes only the paid entitlement.
Grace/hold/paused/recovered states follow the chosen provider and approved product policy across web/native.
Verified refund/revocation or chargeback updates the right purchase source and capacity without deleting finance records.
Restore on a new device/reinstall or account switch reconciles rightful ownership without minting a second purchase.
Concurrent manual grant/store recovery, expiry and suspension follow explicit source precedence and do not undo account suspension.
Family and Business included/extra seat mappings preserve owner counts, accepted members and unexpired reserved invitations.
Existing Family anchored pricing and Business remaining-term fractions remain correct for manual web routes and old accepted invoices.
Native seat/upgrade/downgrade charge/effective date uses approved provider product rules rather than blindly copying manual proration.
Scheduled reduction retains current access until effective boundary and prevents new reservations above the approved next capacity.
Multiple workspaces, ownership transfer and overlapping web/store subscriptions follow explicit binding/precedence without duplicate benefits.
Removed member or expired source cannot buy/transfer/refund another workspace purchase; shared access remains separate from member's own plan.
Correct approved native purchase or qualifying consumption-only flow is shown for the verified channel/storefront.
Permitted native billing bridge/product query/purchase result works on a final test build; WebView manual checkout is not silently shipped as store billing.
Purchase cancellation/network interruption/process death and relaunch reconcile server state without showing unverified success.
Manage/cancel/restore surfaces and required price/renewal disclosures refer to the actual selected store plan and current account.
Deep link/callback to purchase or restored subscription preserves identity, role/MFA/tenant restrictions and prior workspace selection.
Older/offline/cached clients cannot expose unsupported payment routes or override backend entitlement; valid existing web access remains usable.
Exact staged source/schema/grants/providers/products/settings and recoverable isolated actors are verified before the accepted batch.
Supported provider keys/service accounts/certificates remain server-only with appropriate roles, rotation and separate sandbox/production boundaries.
Authenticated processing budgets, monitoring, durable reconciliation and recovery drills detect missing/misordered events without raw proof/token leakage.
Ledger/refund/retention/deletion and operator/channel/terms/disclosure decisions align with actual collected data and provider contracts.
Final signed native artifact contains approved SDK/channel flows; store sandbox purchase/restore/refund/renewal evidence is retained at correct scope.
Rollback preserves purchases/invoices/entitlement attribution and retained synthetic fixtures; final residual resolution/full re-audit remains required.
